description: This file implements the core game logic for a Wordle clone, including user interaction handling, tile animations, game state management, and alert displays.

methods.name: startInteraction
methods.description: Initializes event listeners for mouse clicks and key presses to handle user input.

methods.name: stopInteraction
methods.description: Removes event listeners to disable user input during animations or game end.

methods.name: handleMouseClick
methods.description: Handles click events on virtual keyboard keys, submit, and delete buttons.

methods.name: handleKeyPress
methods.description: Handles physical keyboard key presses for game interaction.

methods.name: deleteKey
methods.description: Removes the last letter from the current guess input.

methods.name: submitGuess
methods.description: Validates and processes the current guess, triggers tile flipping and game state checks.

methods.name: flipTiles
methods.description: Animates tiles flipping and updates their state based on correctness relative to the target word.

methods.name: pressKey
methods.description: Adds a letter to the current guess input grid.

methods.name: getActiveTiles
methods.description: Returns all tiles currently marked as active for input.

methods.name: showAlert
methods.description: Displays a temporary alert message to the user.

methods.name: shakeTiles
methods.description: Animates tiles with a shake effect for invalid input or errors.

methods.name: checkWinLose
methods.description: Checks if the current guess matches the target word or if the game should end.

methods.name: danceTiles
methods.description: Animates tiles with a dance effect upon winning.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game state and UI for a new game session.
